Marvel’s Wolverine Limited Edition PlayStation 5 Collection Pricing Details for India Surface Online [Update: Pre-Order Details Out]

Don’t miss out.

By Aritra Bhowmick 
Updated: Sept. 9, 2026, 7:50 p.m.
Related reads:Wolverine Developer Insomniac Says Logan's Scent Trail Isn't Always on Amid 'Fart Gas' Toggle Requests

Update (September 9, 6:00 PM): The controllers and PS5 Slim faceplate are available for offline pre-orders in limited stock at retailers, including DT Zone’s Punjabi Bagh and Lajpat Nagar 2 outlets, Xtro Games in Gurugram, and Atul Electronics in Chandigarh.

Since the game has not launched yet, most pre-order offers are not listed online, so users will need to contact the stores directly and enquire about them.

More like thisMarvel's Wolverine Just Doesn't Cut It - Beyond Clips

A Marvel’s Wolverine midnight launch event will be held on September 14 from 11:30 PM, with free goodies for attendees. However, only customers who have pre-booked the game will be allowed to attend. The event will take place at retailers and PlayStation Exclusive Stores in Kolkata, Borivali, as well as Games The Shop in Mumbai.

Users can check with their nearby stores to confirm if they are participating in the Marvel’s Wolverine Midnight Launch.

Original story continues.

The pricing details for the PlayStation 5-exclusive Marvel’s Wolverine Limited Edition PS5 Collection in India have surfaced online, revealing pricing details for the DualSense wireless controller, console cover, and more.

The confirmation comes via @VinayakSoni07, a leaker who shares PlayStation-related information. He highlighted that the DualSense controllers will be priced at ₹7,490, while the console cover will be priced at ₹6,390. The Silver Adamantium DualSense controller will also be available for ₹7,490.

As for availability, at the time of writing, while the products are yet to be listed, the leaker claims that the DualSense controller and console cover are available at your nearest PlayStation Exclusive Partner starting today. Previous leaks also mentioned that the Digital Bundle would retail for ₹64,990. However, there are currently no details regarding its availability.

Wolverine PS5 Limited Edition Price in India
DualSense Priced at ₹7,490/-
Console Cover Priced at ₹6,390/- #WolverinePS5 #India pic.twitter.com/5dHpdMY3dk — VINAYAKSONI007 (@VinayakSoni07) September 8, 2026

For those unaware, the Marvel’s Wolverine PS5 Limited Edition bundle includes a PlayStation 5 Digital Edition console, a console cover, and a matching DualSense wireless controller. However, in India, only the DualSense controllers, PS5 Digital Bundle, and the console cover for the standard PS5 will be available, as the PS5 Pro is not launched in the country.

Meanwhile, Sony recently hosted a September State of Play, offering a new look at the Ghost of Yotei story expansion, Echoes of Sekigahara, along with more details on the Monster Hunter Wilds expansion, Ascendance, limited-edition GTA 6 DualSense controllers, and more.

Cloud Gaming Platform JioGames Cloud Adds Cricket 26 to Its Lineup of Games

Click and play.

By Aritra Bhowmick 
Updated: Sept. 10, 2026, 11:07 p.m.
Related reads:Cricket 26 Video Review

JioGames Cloud, the cloud gaming service, has added Cricket 26 to its lineup of games, giving players a cricket title to play through the cloud gaming platform.

More like thisCricket 26 - Official Launch Trailer

Cricket 26 is now available to play on JioGames Cloud, allowing users to play the game across TVs, mobile devices, PCs, web browsers, and more through cloud gaming. However, a Pro Pass subscription is required to play the game, with plans priced at ₹48 for three days, ₹98 for seven days, and ₹298 for 28 days.

Besides Cricket 26, users can also explore and play other games available on JioGames Cloud, including titles such as Mafia 2: Definitive Edition, War Thunder, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, Just Cause 4, Hitman: Absolution, and various other titles.

Cricket 26 is a cricket game where players can take part in different matches and tournaments. It features various teams, game modes, and options that allow players to play matches and manage their own cricket career.

In other news, users interested in buying gift cards and vouchers for Steam, PlayStation, and Xbox can also check out the JioGames Store. Users interested in buying games can also do so through the platform.

about.description: During the moments it manages to keep everything together, Cricket 26 is genuinely capable of providing an entertaining and challenging form of bat-on-ball action that elevates it above the last couple of entries in the series like a lofted drive over the infield. However, the countless glitches and bugs still present even after a few post-release patches means it’s prone to break down as often as Ben Stokes’ body, and its small handful of new modes are either seriously undercooked or inaccessible at this stage, making it far from being a must-have upgrade for fans of Cricket 24 in its current form. Cricket 26 is a bit like fledgeling Aussie opener Sam Konstas – undoubtedly capable of genuine brilliance in bursts, but still clearly a work in progress not quite ready for the top of the order.
